messages.subject: Dynamic Energy Budget course/workshop/symposium 2025
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

For those interested in the DEB theory the biennial workshop is running next year (in the Greek Islands!). Details below:

The website of DEB2025 is located here https://deb2025.sciencesconf.org/ <https://url.au.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/qistC4QZNwCzlooW0uxh5I4y1A2?domain=deb2025.sciencesconf.org>.

Registration of the Tele-course is already open and we hope as many experts as possible will join the MOOC discussion groups (27 Feb - 17 Apr 2025). We would also like to revive the local discussion groups that will meet weekly (https://deb2025.sciencesconf.org/resource/page/id/35 <https://url.au.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/9DkeC3Q8MvCX2BBMAfgfLIQzqDx?domain=deb2025.sciencesconf.org>).

The dates are as follows:
PART 1: 5-week International Tele-course - general online theoretical part (27 Feb - 17 Apr 2025)
PART 2: 8-day Thematic School - practical training part (26 May - 3 June 2025)
PART 3: 3-day International DEB Symposium (4-6 June, 2025)
All the best and merry Christmas!
Mike

messages.subject: endotherm Shiny app
messages.body_plain:
Dear NicheMapR users,

I've finally made a Shiny app for the endotherm model <http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/app_direct/endotherm/>, for the moment just using the global monthly climatology of New et al. 2002. Please let me know if anything's not working properly with it.

All the best,
Mike
